# graphiant_device_decommission (Resource)

Drives the hardware-return decommission workflow (request → approve → clear), keyed by device serial number rather than device id (a different identity space than every other resource in this provider). Action-shaped: Delete performs a best-effort clear-return and does not fail if the server has already cleared it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Action-shaped: drives the hardware-return workflow. Keyed by serial number,
# not device id.
resource "graphiant_device_decommission" "retire" {
  device_serials = ["SN-0001", "SN-0002"]

  approve = true
  clear   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_serials` (List of String)

### Optional

- `approve` (Boolean) When true, also calls the approve-return step.
- `clear` (Boolean) When true, also calls the clear-return step.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Derived from device_serials; not a server-assigned identifier.
- `requested` (Boolean) Whether the server currently shows a return requested for these serials (from inventory).
